messages.text: How do I use this store credit? I dont see it in my profile when I check out.      Regards,    Niel

Hi Niel,

Good news: the credit is there. I can see $731.95 USD sitting on your account under (email hidden)

It isn't a code, so there's nothing to type in. It's attached to that email address, which is why it doesn't show up in a guest checkout. Add the miner to your cart, then at the top of the checkout page click "Log in" and sign in with (email hidden) (you'll get a one-time code by email, no password needed). Once you're signed in, the store credit appears at the payment step as its own payment option, and you can put all or part of it against the order. Anything above the credit goes on your card as usual.

Sorry about the earlier mention of a code, that was our wording being off, not a different credit.

If you sign in and still don't see it at payment, just reply here with the email you used and I'll get it applied to your order directly.

Thanks for sticking with us, Niel.

Sarah, HeliumDeploy
